libraries.reason: Rejected. The sound-samples page allows use in a finished work but forbids selling or redistributing the files as samples or as a sampler instrument. That is a custom licence, not CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, or public domain.

The library is CC0 and the GitHub tree is fetchable, but its notes are a sparse grid (about a minor third or a fifth apart). No catalog voicing of these chords is covered, so the files were not used. The Freesound copies of the same grid disagree between title and filename.
Searches for instrument notes returned photographs, a G-major pizzicato scale, and one short pizzicato file. None of those is a pitch-checked single note for every tone of one of these chords.

source_mix.rule: A strike is that chord: a whole-chord file of the same root, quality, and bass, or the chord assembled from single notes recorded at those pitches. No origin is more than half the strikes unless the notes name it, or it is the only origin that can play them. Share counts strikes only; the texture bed is separate. Nothing is pitch-shifted or time-stretched. Every source has a title, author, license, and page.

notes: Per chord: Ebsus2 assembled notes via guitar (uiowa); Cm-add9 whole-chord file via fat synth (musicmatter); Ab6-9 assembled notes via cello (freesound); Bb7sus4 assembled notes via piano (freesound); Eb6 whole-chord file via choir (musicmatter). Strike share: uiowa 1/5, musicmatter 2/5, freesound 2/5. Texture: Quiet Neighborhood Ambience (light wind, no people) (openverse, CC0-1.0). No pitch-shift and no time-stretch. Assembled tones keep their recorded pitch and are layered with a small onset jitter.

Philharmonia Orchestra samples were rejected: the sound-samples page allows a finished work but forbids selling or redistributing the files as samples or as a sampler instrument, which is a custom licence. VSCO 2 Community Edition is CC0 and fetchable, but its note grid does not cover a catalog voicing of these chords. Wikimedia Commons had no pitch-checked single note for every tone of one chord. UIowa violin pizzicato, marimba, flute, and vibraphone were measured and did not cover a full voicing. The Freesound piano notes are feelander's CC0 re-upload of University of Iowa MIS piano (pack 17718); MTG cello notes are a different CC BY 3.0 recording.
